title: Implement WAV lossless master writer
description:
Create WavWriter, a libsndfile-backed lossless WAV master writer that accepts interleaved audio buffers, preserves the negotiated source sample rate and bit depth, and writes RF64 when the file exceeds 4 GiB.

Before editing, inspect:
- Any existing src/recording/ directory layout for naming conventions
- The project CMakeLists.txt for libsndfile linkage

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implementation requirements:
1. Declare class WavWriter in WavWriter.hpp with at minimum: open(path, channels, sampleRate, sampleFormat), write(const float*, frameCount), finalize(), abort(), and isOpen(). Store conversion provenance metadata (native vs quantized vs resampled) as a field retrievable via a provenance() accessor.
2. Implement WavWriter in WavWriter.cpp using libsndfile (sf_open, sf_writef_float / sf_writef_int / sf_writef_double as appropriate). On open(), select the SF_FORMAT that matches the negotiated source format. Use SF_FORMAT_RF64 when cumulative byte count will exceed 4 GiB (track running byte count and switch format before the 4 GiB boundary, or open as RF64 from the start when the caller signals unbounded length). On finalize(), flush and close the SNDFILE handle; on abort(), close and delete the partial file.
3. sampleFormat should be an enum (e.g., SampleFormat) defined in or near WavWriter.hpp covering at least Int16, Int24, Int32, Float32, Float64.
4. Do not perform blocking I/O inside a PipeWire realtime callback; WavWriter::write() is expected to be called from a non-realtime writer thread.
5. Handle disk-full: if sf_writef returns fewer frames than requested, set an error state queryable via lastError().

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: src/recording/WavWriter.hpp exists and declares WavWriter class with open, write, finalize, abort, isOpen, provenance, and lastError public interface
src/recording/WavWriter.cpp exists and uses libsndfile sf_open / sf_writef / sf_close for WAV writing
WavWriter stores and exposes conversion provenance metadata (native, quantized, resampled)
WavWriter handles RF64 for files that may exceed 4 GiB
WavWriter::abort() closes the handle and removes the partial file
Disk-full condition (short sf_writef return) sets a queryable error state
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify any file outside src/recording/WavWriter.hpp and src/recording/WavWriter.cpp

allowed: define SampleFormat enum locally or in a shared recording header within allowed_write_paths
choose RF64 strategy: open as RF64 from start when unbounded, or reopen on threshold
forbidden: introduce new third-party dependencies beyond libsndfile
create a base class hierarchy for writers
